notes: DuckAI understands you in 30+ languages and answers aloud in yours (its language pack and Duckling 1 download by themselves over Wi-Fi); 'five seconds timer' works; its glow fills the whole screen; the screen stays on while you talk. A much better keyboard: next-word suggestions, keys that pop up, numbers on a hold or a number row, double-space full stop, slide Delete for whole words, paste what you copied, emoji suggestions. DuckOS sounds: 6 ringtones, 6 notification sounds, 3 alarms, a quick chime when your face unlocks the phone, no click when it locks. Back no longer restarts the home screen.
